{{Quote|According to the positional system coordinates, this is Balnab, a stellar remnant in its emerging stages of organic development.|C-3PO|<ref name="ND" />}}
'''Balnab''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] close to the world of [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]].

==History==
[[File:BalnabLandscape-ND.png|thumb|left|220px|The landscape of Balnab]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Balnab was in its early stages of [[Sentience/Legends|organic]] development and was home to stranded members of a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Unidentified tentacle-faced species/Legends|tentacle-faced beings]] who took the name [[Balnab (group)/Legends|Balnab]].At some point, a providence-like ship crashed into a valley on balnab. This became the command center of some pit droids.

The Balnab civilization later found itself enslaved by a tyrant calling himself [[Albee Dewaw/Legends|Albee Dewaw]], who appeared before the natives as an enormous [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Terrified by the superior technology of Dewaw, the Balnab obeyed his every whim.

At around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived on the planet shortly after a misadventure on Patitite Pattuna and revealed Albee Dewaw to be a projection controlled by a group of [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]]. Upon learning this, the Balnabs promptly attacked their droid masters, while C-3PO and R2-D2 quietly left the scene.
